_note: Closes/advances Guinea-Bissau local-finance-law leads under gw-constituicao-poder-local. Two new nodes minted (Lei n.5/96, Lei n.6/97), both with real vlex.pt text confirming they cite Constitution articles inside the 105-118 (Poder Local) range. IMPORTANT: also resolves a contradictory existing _dropped no-document entry for gw-lei-7-96-financas-locais -> gw-constituicao-poder-local (see patched entry in gw-leadchase-lei7-96.json) -- a fresh, independently-verified fetch of the same vlex.pt page (confirmed by two separate readers) found the citation the earlier round said was absent, right in the preamble: 'no uso dos poderes Constitucionais definidos nos artigos 86, alinea b) e 110, o seguinte' (the '110' renders as '1l0' in the source's own text due to an apparent OCR-style glyph substitution, confirmed by cross-checking against Constitution Art. 110's own text, which is exactly the finance-regime delegation article). Decreto-Lei n.4/96 was also found (real text) but its preamble cites only Art. 87 (outside the 105-118 range) -- not minted, thematic-only. Lei n.4/2015 (Lei Eleitoral Autarquica) still not found. Lei n.5/2018/Lei n.1/2021 (Codigo da Administracao Autarquica) primary text still not found; the existing no-node-yet lead for gw-lei-7-96-financas-locais -> Lei 5/2018 is left as-is, now re-confirmed on real bytes via the citing tax-code page at kontaktu.mef.gw.

reports.title: Lei n.º 5/96, de 16 de Setembro — Lei de Bases das Autarquias Locais
reports.description: Guinea-Bissau's framework law establishing the bases of local authorities (autarquias locais) — their existence, organization and organs — enacted pursuant to Constitution Articles 106, 109, 113 and 114.

reports.title: Lei n.º 6/97, de 2 de Dezembro — Lei-quadro da criação de Municípios
reports.description: Guinea-Bissau's framework law governing the creation of municípios, including the consultation-of-affected-population requirement drawn from Constitution Article 117.

dependencies.basis: Assim a Assembleia Nacional Popular decreta, no uso dos poderes Constitucionais definidos nos artigos 86º, alínea b) e 1l0º [110º], o seguinte: ARTIGO 1º (Autonomia financeira e patrimonial das Autarquias)
Assim, a Assembleia Nacional Popular decreta, nos termos dos artigos 106º, 109º, 113º e 114º da Constituição da República, o seguinte: CAPÍTULO I DAS AUTARQUIAS LOCAIS

A vontade das populações abrangidas, expressa em consultas nos termos do artigo 117º da Constituição; As razões de ordem histórica e cultural; Os factores geográficos, demográficos, económicos, sociais, culturais e administrativos [criteria for creating a município under this law].

_dropped.why: Found real text (vlex.pt/vid/municipios-estabelecimento-respectivos-limites-36574704) establishing the municípios of Bafatá, Bissau, Bolama etc. Its preamble cites only 'nos termos da alínea a) do nº1 do artigo 87º da Constituição' -- Article 87, outside gw-constituicao-poder-local's covered range (Arts. 105-118). Thematic connection only (it's about municípios); no citation into the covered chapter found. No edge minted -- no corpus node created for this law either, since it doesn't resolve anything.
